title: Warm Argentinian Bulgur Wheat Pilaf
description: A funky and snappy Argentinian dish featuring bulgur wheat, perfect for curing hangovers, made with a tadka and pescatarian-friendly ingredients, served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the bulgur wheat and water, and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff the bulgur wheat with a fork and add it to the skillet with the shrimp mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a terracotta dish and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
